children: SCORES HOLDING CO INC reported results for the 2025 quarter, with revenue of $52.8K and net income of $37.31K, compared with $73.5K and $31.88K, respectively, in the prior-year quarter. Diluted EPS was $0 for both periods.
¹ Reported as “Total Revenue”. ² Reported as “Net Income”. ³ Reported as “INCOME PER SHARE-Basic and Diluted”.
Revenue declined to $52.8K from $73.5K primarily because one revenue source was not recognized due to collectability considerations under ASC 606.
The company continues a licensing model serving six U.S. clubs, with royalties or flat fees remaining primary revenue channels.
General and administrative expenses were materially reduced, driven by lower accounting and SEC fees and the elimination of an insurance policy.
Operating cash flow improved to net $100 provided versus $(17.3K) in the prior quarter, aided by receivable collections and reductions in payables.
Management is pursuing complementary acquisitions and investments and may seek financing to support growth and expansion of its licensing business.
